description: This script provides functions to manage OCI containers, including starting, stopping, listing, and executing commands within containers, as well as handling container specifications and states. It appears to be a test utility for container management via JSON-RPC over curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a specified bundle directory or tarball.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts an OCI container using a Dobby JSON specification file.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container identified by containerId.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specified container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a specified container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about the available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop handling user input to perform container management operations.
